Original Stage 3 synchronous stop discarded unread JS batches and marked a generic loss instead of attempting bounded final drain. Added verified stop ACK/cursor drain and regression state machine.
An Activity-owned stop coroutine could be cancelled by My Sites rotation/navigation while JS drains. Made stop process-owned and UI only awaits, preserving session through rotation.
FileProvider-based sharing would require writing the private RAM log to a disk cache. Implemented a non-exported read-only ContentProvider pipe and exact lifetime check, no temp file.
A syntactically closed JSONL footer could be misreported as a complete diagnostic despite lost ports/worker interruptions. Recorder and manifest now count interruptions and label incomplete sessions.
The original ordinary 12-replies/5s rate could starve final drain, and an expired 45m session needed an explicit Stop action. Added separate bounded diagnostic rate and finalizable session status.
